t: Kamma tzarik leharchiq bishat qeriat shema min gerap shel rei
s: Kamma tzarik leharchiq bishat qeriat shema min gerap shel rei ubo d' seipim: gerap shel rei veabit shel me raglayim — tzarik leharchiq mehem d' ammot ulepanayv kimlo enayv kemo min hatztzoa ume raglayim atzman, ap al pi sheen bahen kelum, vaapillu en bahem reach ra, shekkevan shehem meyuchadim lekak — hare hem kimchitztzot shel bet hakkisse, sheasur min hattora mishshum "vehaya machaneka qadosh". Velaken en hatalat rebiit mayim o yoter moelet kelum bigrap shel rei veabit kemo shemmoelet beme raglayim atzman, lepi shemme raglayim leachar shennapelu laaretz — en issuran ella middibre soperim, lepikak heqellu bahen lebattelam bammayim, mah sheen ken bigrap veabit sheissuran min hattora. Veod shemme raglayim hem tzelulin umitorbin im rebiit mayim shennoten bahem umitbattelim bahem, abal gerap veabit en mah shebbalua bahem mitareb bammayim sheyyitbattel bahen:

Gerap veabit shenehem shel cheres hem, ella shehamyuchad liri — niqra gerap, vehamyuchad leme raglayim — niqra abit. Vehu haddin im hem shel etz, mippene shehacheres o etz shel gerap veabit hu mubla betoko harbeh umale zuhama umaus kebet hakkisse. Abal im hem shel matteket o shel zekukit o shel cheres metzuppeh bizkukit (o bibdil veoperet), kevan sheenan mublaim umeleim zuhama kol kak — muttar liqrot kenegdan im hem rechutzim yapeh, ubilbad shello yihyeh bahen reach. Vaapillu shel cheres o shel etz, im hem meyuchadim gam ken letashmish acher, kegon lishpok letokan shopekin — enan domin lebet hakkisse, veim en bahem tzoa velo reach — muttar. Vehu haddin apillu keli hamyuchad lehashtin bilbad ella shebbekol paam shemmashtin noten betoko rebiit mayim lebattelam:

Gerap veabit shekkapa alehem keli acher — muttar, shekkissuy moil lahem kemo letzoa ume raglayim. Abal im kapa haggerap o heabit atzmo — lo hoil kelum, shekkevan shehu balua betoko — hare baro ketoko. Abal shel matteket uzekukit sheeno rachutz mittoko — moelet lo kepiyya, kevan sheen issuro ella mittoko:

Bayit sheyyesh bo tzoa o me raglayim o gerap o abit — muttar liqrot bo keshemmarchiq mehem d' ammot milleacharayv, veen omerim shekkol habbayit hu kedi[n] d' ammot. Veim yesh babbayit mitta gaboah y' tepachim umechitztzoteha maggiot (lepachot mig' tepachim samuk) laaretz vehaggerap vehatztzoa hem achore hammitta — hare hammitta chashuba kimchitztza lehapsiq beno lebenehem, veen tzarik leharchiq mehem d' ammot. Vehu shettihyeh hammitta chotzetzet mikkotel lekotel, veim lav — enah chashuba kimchitztza, shehi betela legabbe habbayit (abal im asa mechitztza leshem kak — en tzarik lachtzotz mikkotel lekotel, apillu hi mechitztzat aray kegon machtzelet o sadin) (ayyen siman sht"v). Veim hinnicham tachat hammitta ap al pi sheeno gaboah y' tepachim, im mechitztzoteha maggiot ad pachot mig' tepachim samuk laaretz, shekkistumim umekussim hem bimchitztzot hammitta, shekkol pachot mig' tepachim kelabud hu. Vehu haddin im napal alehem keli veyesh avir qetzat ben hakkeli laqqarqa, kegon shehakkeli bolet qetzat mitztzad echad, im hu avir pachot mig' tepachim baggobah — kelabud hu. Abal im hakkeli patuach lemala apillu pachot mig' tepachim — asur, mippene shetztzarik sheyyihyeh mekussim velo megullim:
